_provenance: Derived from the KPMG brand palette by snapping each brand hue angle to a lightness that passes the dataviz six checks. Validated with scripts/validate_palette.js: ALL CHECKS PASS in both modes on the adjacent pairlist, and slots 1-3 also pass under --pairs all. Do not edit a hex without re-running the validator.

categorical._note: Fixed slot order. The order IS the colourblind-safety mechanism — never cycle, never reorder, never generate a sixth hue. Series cap: 5 on adjacent forms (bars, stacks, lines), 3 on all-pairs forms (scatter, bubble, small multiples).

portfolios._note: Slots 1-3, which are the three that clear the harder all-pairs gate. The three portfolios share scatter and small-multiple forms on the roll-up, so they must.

sequential._note: One hue, light to dark, for continuous magnitude — heatmaps, choropleths, concentration.

ordinal._note: Discrete ORDERED categories — scenario severity, vintage, decile, rating grade, delinquency bucket. Validated with --ordinal: monotone lightness, adjacent dL >= 0.06, surface-end clears 2:1. Seven steps; interpolate the sequential ramp if more are needed.

diverging._note: Signed statistics — weight of evidence, correlation, sensitivity. Blue against magenta: one cool pole, one warm pole, neutral grey midpoint. Red and amber stay reserved for risk and warning semantics, so they are deliberately NOT used here.

status._note: Reserved meaning. Never used for a series. Always shipped with an icon and a label, because on the light surface warning and serious sit below 3:1 by design and the pairing is the mitigation.

marks._note: Fixed across every chart in the app. From the dataviz mark specs.
